Other wins came from Wesley Smith in the triple jump and Jamie Webb in the pole vault while Richard David cracked the 50 second mark in his first one-lap run of the year.
Stuart Faben pulled out one of his best ever early season throws in the javelin and Wesley Smith added further points in an event in which we have needed some depth.

Wesley Smith gained useful 'B' points and provided another name for our hammer rankings. In the javelin Wesley was our 'A' man and showed a useful improvement to 54m+ while Kevin Brown filled the 'B' slot.

Wesley Smith gained silver in the 'B' javelin improving yet again to 57.29m. Lee Newman pipped Kevin Brown in the discus but Dave Readle produced a magnificent 16.61m effort in the shot to surprisingly reverse the tables on Lee who is once again warming to this event.

In the 'B', javelin positions were reversed with Wesley Smith's stunning win with a 60m plus p.b. But it was the shot where Newham finally faltered, as the often erratic Mark Proctor failed to post a distance with three no throws.
Wesley Smith had a busy afternoon with the throws, flitting from one event to the next, and excelled in a high quality javelin competition where he won with 54.50 metres.
